import pandas as pd
def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize species: case variants and typo Gentto -> Gentoo
    species_map = {'adelie': 'Adelie', 'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap', 'gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'gentto': 'Gentoo'}
    # strip and lower then map
    s = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    lower = s.str.lower()
    mapped = lower.map(species_map)
    df['species'] = mapped.where(mapped.notna(), s)
    # keep only allowed values, others become NaN (will be dropped in answer)
    allowed = {'Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo'}
    df.loc[~df['species'].isin(allowed), 'species'] = pd.NA
    # body_mass_g is text with commas like "3,900" -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
    # flipper_length_mm has negative values due to sign error -> absolute value
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    # optional range filter per rules (keeps valid body_mass)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
